name: 44139 · Solon, OH
findings: ZIP 44139 (Solon) has 147 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44139 (Solon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44139 (Solon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
